description: Namur - Travaux de voiries planifiés is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Inventaire des travaux prévus au budget dans les prochains mois ou planifiés sur les prochaines années. Responsables des données: Service Technique Voirie. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility, Administration and Public Services. Its keywords are travaux, Voirie, entretien, trottoir, raclage, béton. The portal shows 5,435 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
